notes.live_llm_judge: Live Ollama judge (qwen3:4b) with on-disk cache at /home/morry/Documents/HarnessSEC/ActiveSecHarness/results/.llm_judge_cache.json. Tiny prompts (BLOCK/ALLOW). Per-case fallback on transport/parse failure.
notes.activesec_ring0: Decisions never read the fixture's kind or tags. Real NetworkGuard, CredentialGuard, MalwareGuard, CommandDeobfuscator, SandboxGuard argument validation, WorkspaceProvenanceLedger (for fixtures declared context_tainted) and SecurityKernel.execute_tool_call (file reads). Thin adapters only where the fixture has no archive bytes (zip-bomb and polyglot markers, reported as ArchiveFixtureAdapter). Shell commands are validated and decided, never executed.
notes.hybrid_llm_plus_ring0: Neurosymbolic hybrid: Ring-0 is authoritative. Live LLM is consulted for advisory signal on every case but cannot override a Ring-0 allow (avoids small-judge FPR inflation).
notes.intervals: Clopper-Pearson exact 95% CIs (scipy beta.ppf, or exact bisection on the binomial tail when scipy is absent).
notes.network: Benign network fixtures resolve pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org through real DNS; the run aborts if they cannot be resolved.
